verses.sloka: स लम्ब शिखरे लम्बे लम्ब तोयद सम्निभे ।सत्त्वम् आस्थाय मेधावी हनुमान् मारुत आत्मजः ॥५-३-१॥
verses.transliteration: sa lamba śikhare lambe lamba toyada samnibhe ।sattvam āsthāya medhāvī hanumān māruta ātmajaḥ ॥5-3-1॥

translations.english: The mighty son of the Windgod, intelligent Hanuman, an elephant among vanaras, standing on the peak of the Lamba which looked like a high rainbearing cloud and relying on his energy, entered by night the city of Lanka, ruled by Ravana rich in delightful forests, groves and water pools.
translations.hindi: बुद्धिमान्‌ तथा महाबलवान्‌ कपिश्रेष्ठ पवननन्दन हनुमानजी ने धैर्य घारण पूवंक महामेघ की तरह लम्ब नामक पर्वत के उच्च शिखर पर स्थित लंकापुरी में रात के समय प्रवेश किया । वह रावण की लंकापुरी उपवनों तथा स्वादिष्ट जल वाले कूप, तडाग, बावली से पूर्ण थी

verses.sloka: निशि लन्काम् महा सत्त्वः विवेश कपि कुन्जरः ।रम्य कानन तोय आढ्याम् पुरीम् रावण पालिताम् ॥५-३-२॥
verses.transliteration: niśi lankām mahā sattvaḥ viveśa kapi kunjaraḥ ।ramya kānana toya āḍhyām purīm rāvaṇa pālitām ॥5-3-2॥

translations.english: The mighty son of the Windgod, intelligent Hanuman, an elephant among vanaras, standing on the peak of the Lamba which looked like a high rainbearing cloud and relying on his energy, entered by night the city of Lanka, ruled by Ravana rich in delightful forests, groves and water pools.

verses.sloka: शारद अम्बु धर प्रख्यैः भवनैः उपशोभिताम् ।सागर उपम निर्घोषाम् सागर अनिल सेविताम् ॥५-३-३॥
verses.transliteration: śārada ambu dhara prakhyaiḥ bhavanaiḥ upaśobhitām ।sāgara upama nirghoṣām sāgara anila sevitām ॥5-3-3॥

translations.english: Hanuman, happy to reach Lanka, stood on its rampart and surveyed the city of land which was splendid with beautiful mansions overcast with autumnal clouds pierced by glittering streaks of lightning, served by planets and stars with mild winds blowing (out of fear of Ravana), with the roaring sounds of the sea and with a wellfed army like Vitapavati (that is Alaka, the capital of Kubera, halfbrother of Ravana and the treasurer of celestials), which had elephants sationed at the outer gates, provided with white archways and protected by serpents like the auspicious city of Bhogavati (capital of Patala). Surrounded by a golden rampart, the city resembled Amaravati, the capital of Indra, decorated with flags fluttering, echoing with the jingling sounds of small bells.
translations.hindi: बह्‌ शरत्कालीन बादलों की तरह सफेद भवनों से सुशोभित थी । उसमें सदा समुद्र जैसा गर्जन सुन पडता था और वहाँ समुद्री पवन सदा बहा करता था

verses.sloka: सुपुष्ट बल सम्गुप्ताम् यथैव विटपावतीम् ।चारु तोरण निर्यूहाम् पाण्डुर द्वार तोरणाम्॥५-३-४॥
verses.transliteration: supuṣṭa bala samguptām yathaiva viṭapāvatīm ।cāru toraṇa niryūhām pāṇḍura dvāra toraṇām॥5-3-4॥

translations.english: Hanuman, happy to reach Lanka, stood on its rampart and surveyed the city of land which was splendid with beautiful mansions overcast with autumnal clouds pierced by glittering streaks of lightning, served by planets and stars with mild winds blowing (out of fear of Ravana), with the roaring sounds of the sea and with a wellfed army like Vitapavati (that is Alaka, the capital of Kubera, halfbrother of Ravana and the treasurer of celestials), which had elephants sationed at the outer gates, provided with white archways and protected by serpents like the auspicious city of Bhogavati (capital of Patala). Surrounded by a golden rampart, the city resembled Amaravati, the capital of Indra, decorated with flags fluttering, echoing with the jingling sounds of small bells.
translations.hindi: विटपावती नगरी की तरह लंकापुरी की भी रखवाली के लिए परम । हृष्टपुष्ट राक्षसी सेना पुरी के चारों ओर नियत थी । उसके तोरणद्वारों | पर मदमत्त हाथी झूमा करते थे । उसके तोरणद्वार सफेद रंग के थे

verses.sloka: भुजग आचरिताम् गुप्ताम् शुभाम् भोगवतीम् इव ।ताम् सविद्युत् घन आकीर्णाम् ज्योतिः मार्ग निषेविताम् ॥५-३-५॥
verses.transliteration: bhujaga ācaritām guptām śubhām bhogavatīm iva ।tām savidyut ghana ākīrṇām jyotiḥ mārga niṣevitām ॥5-3-5॥

translations.english: Hanuman, happy to reach Lanka, stood on its rampart and surveyed the city of land which was splendid with beautiful mansions overcast with autumnal clouds pierced by glittering streaks of lightning, served by planets and stars with mild winds blowing (out of fear of Ravana), with the roaring sounds of the sea and with a wellfed army like Vitapavati (that is Alaka, the capital of Kubera, halfbrother of Ravana and the treasurer of celestials), which had elephants sationed at the outer gates, provided with white archways and protected by serpents like the auspicious city of Bhogavati (capital of Patala). Surrounded by a golden rampart, the city resembled Amaravati, the capital of Indra, decorated with flags fluttering, echoing with the jingling sounds of small bells.
translations.hindi: वह सब ओर से सर्पो द्वारा सुरक्षित, सर्पो को भोगवतीपुरी की तरह सुरक्षित थी । वह दामिनी युक्त बादलों से घिरी थी श्रथवा उसकी सड़कों पर पर्याप्त प्रकाश था

verses.sloka: चण्ड मारुत निर्ह्रादाम् यथा इन्द्रस्य अमरावतीम् ।शातकुम्भेन महता प्राकारेण अभिसम्वृताम् ॥५-३-६॥
verses.transliteration: caṇḍa māruta nirhrādām yathā indrasya amarāvatīm ।śātakumbhena mahatā prākāreṇa abhisamvṛtām ॥5-3-6॥

translations.english: Hanuman, happy to reach Lanka, stood on its rampart and surveyed the city of land which was splendid with beautiful mansions overcast with autumnal clouds pierced by glittering streaks of lightning, served by planets and stars with mild winds blowing (out of fear of Ravana), with the roaring sounds of the sea and with a wellfed army like Vitapavati (that is Alaka, the capital of Kubera, halfbrother of Ravana and the treasurer of celestials), which had elephants sationed at the outer gates, provided with white archways and protected by serpents like the auspicious city of Bhogavati (capital of Patala). Surrounded by a golden rampart, the city resembled Amaravati, the capital of Indra, decorated with flags fluttering, echoing with the jingling sounds of small bells.
translations.hindi: इन्द्र की अमरावतीपुरी की तरह लंकापुरी में भो प्रचण्ड वायु सन्‌ सन्‌ करता चला करता था । उसके चारों श्रोर बड़ा ऊचा ग्रौर लंबा चौड़ा सोने की दीवारों का परकोटा खिँचा हुआ था

verses.sloka: किन्किणी जाल घोषाभिः पताकाभिः अलम्कृताम् ।आसाद्य सहसा हृष्टः प्राकारम् अभिपेदिवान् ॥५-३-७॥
verses.transliteration: kinkiṇī jāla ghoṣābhiḥ patākābhiḥ alamkṛtām ।āsādya sahasā hṛṣṭaḥ prākāram abhipedivān ॥5-3-7॥

translations.english: Hanuman, happy to reach Lanka, stood on its rampart and surveyed the city of land which was splendid with beautiful mansions overcast with autumnal clouds pierced by glittering streaks of lightning, served by planets and stars with mild winds blowing (out of fear of Ravana), with the roaring sounds of the sea and with a wellfed army like Vitapavati (that is Alaka, the capital of Kubera, halfbrother of Ravana and the treasurer of celestials), which had elephants sationed at the outer gates, provided with white archways and protected by serpents like the auspicious city of Bhogavati (capital of Patala). Surrounded by a golden rampart, the city resembled Amaravati, the capital of Indra, decorated with flags fluttering, echoing with the jingling sounds of small bells.
translations.hindi: उसमें छोटी छोटी घंटियों के जाल जगह जगह बने हुए थे, जिनकी घंटियाँ सदा बजा करती थीं । जगह जगह पताकाएँ फहरा रही थीं । उस लंकापुरी के परकोटे की दीवाल पर हनुमानजी प्रसन्नता-पूर्वक सहसा कूद . कर चढ़ गए

verses.sloka: विस्मय आविष्ट हृदयः पुरीम् आलोक्य सर्वतः ।जाम्बूनदमयैः द्वारैः वैदूर्य कृत वेदिकैः ॥५-३-८॥
verses.transliteration: vismaya āviṣṭa hṛdayaḥ purīm ālokya sarvataḥ ।jāmbūnadamayaiḥ dvāraiḥ vaidūrya kṛta vedikaiḥ ॥5-3-8॥

translations.english: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.
translations.hindi: उस परकोटे पर से उन्होंने उस पुरी को चारों श्रोर से देखा श्रौर देख कर वे विस्मित हुए। क्योंकि उन्होंने देखा कि, उस पुरी के भवनों के दरवाजे सोने से और चबूतरे पन्ने से बने हुए थे

verses.sloka: मणि स्फटिक मुक्ताभिः मणि कुट्टिम भूषितैः ।तप्त हाटक निर्यूहैः  राजत अमल पाण्डुरैः ॥५-३-९॥
verses.transliteration: maṇi sphaṭika muktābhiḥ maṇi kuṭṭima bhūṣitaiḥ ।tapta hāṭaka niryūhaiḥ  rājata amala pāṇḍuraiḥ ॥5-3-9॥

translations.english: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.

verses.sloka: वैदूर्य तल सोपानैः  स्फाटिक अन्तर पाम्सुभिः ।चारु सम्जवन उपेतैः  खम् इव उत्पतितैः  शुभैः ॥५-३-१०॥
verses.transliteration: vaidūrya tala sopānaiḥ  sphāṭika antara pāmsubhiḥ ।cāru samjavana upetaiḥ  kham iva utpatitaiḥ  śubhaiḥ ॥5-3-10॥

translations.english: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे-“मन्दमारुतसञ्चारां यथेन्द्रस्यामरावतीम्‌ ।” उस पुरी के भवनों की दीवालें हीरा स्फटिक मोती तथा धन्य मणियों की बनी हुई थीं । उनका ऊपरी भाग सुवर्ण ग्रौर चाँदी का बना हुआ था NR वैड्यतलसोपानेः स्फाटिकान्तरपांसुभिः । चारुसञ्जवनोपेतेः खमिवोत्पतितेः शुभेः

verses.sloka: क्रौन्च बर्हिण सम्घुष्टे राज हम्स निषेवितैः ।तूर्य आभरण निर्घोषैः  सर्वतः प्रतिनादिताम् ॥५-३-११॥
verses.transliteration: kraunca barhiṇa samghuṣṭe rāja hamsa niṣevitaiḥ ।tūrya ābharaṇa nirghoṣaiḥ  sarvataḥ pratināditām ॥5-3-11॥

translations.english: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.
translations.hindi: भवनों के द्वारों पर क्रौंच, मोर श्रादि पक्षी सुहावनी बोलियाँ बोल रहे थे । राजहंस भलग ही वहाँ की शोभा बढ़ा रहे थे । सर्वत्र नगाड़ों श्रौर आभूषणों के शब्द सुनाई पड़ते थे

verses.sloka: वस्वोकसारा प्रतिमाम् समीक्ष्य नगरीम् ततः ।खम् इव उत्पतिताम् लन्काम् जहर्ष हनुमान् कपिः ॥५-३-१२॥
verses.transliteration: vasvokasārā pratimām samīkṣya nagarīm tataḥ ।kham iva utpatitām lankām jaharṣa hanumān kapiḥ ॥5-3-12॥

translations.english: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार समृद्धशालिनी प्रौर ्राकाशस्पशिनी भ्रलकापुरी की तरह उस लंकापुरी को देख, हनुमानजी बहुत प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: ताम् समीक्ष्य पुरीम् लन्काम् राक्षस अधिपतेः शुभाम् ।अनुत्तमाम् ऋद्धि युताम् चिन्तयाम् आस वीर्यवान् ॥५-३-१३॥
verses.transliteration: tām samīkṣya purīm lankām rākṣasa adhipateḥ śubhām ।anuttamām ṛddhi yutām cintayām āsa vīryavān ॥5-3-13॥

translations.english: Gazing at the enchanting, auspicious, prosperous city of the king of demons mighty Hanuman began to reflect:

verses.sloka: न इयम् अन्येन नगरी शक्या धर्षयितुम् बलात् ।रक्षिता रावण बलैः उद्यत आयुध धारिभिः ॥५-३-१४॥
verses.transliteration: na iyam anyena nagarī śakyā dharṣayitum balāt ।rakṣitā rāvaṇa balaiḥ udyata āyudha dhāribhiḥ ॥5-3-14॥

translations.english: 'It is not possible to attack this city by to outsiders as it is protected by the forces of Ravana with their weapons ready(to attack).

verses.sloka: कुमुद अन्गदयोः वा अपि सुषेणस्य महा कपेः ।प्रसिद्धा इयम् भवेत् भूमिः मैन्द द्विविदयोः अपि ॥५-३-१५॥
verses.transliteration: kumuda angadayoḥ vā api suṣeṇasya mahā kapeḥ ।prasiddhā iyam bhavet bhūmiḥ mainda dvividayoḥ api ॥5-3-15॥

translations.english: 'This land can be reached by Kumuda and Angada or the great vanara Sushena and even by Mainda and Dvivida.
translations.hindi: परन्तु कुमुद, भ्रङ्गद, महाकपि सुषेण, म॑न्द, द्विविद, सूर्यपुत्र सुग्रीव श्रौर कुश जैसे लोमधारी रीछों में श्रेष्ठ जाम्बवान और में -बस ये ही लोग यहाँ ग्रा सकते हें

verses.sloka: विवस्वतः तनूजस्य हरेः च कुश पर्वणः ।ऋक्षस्य केतु मालस्य मम चैव गतिः भवेत् ॥५-३-१६॥
verses.transliteration: vivasvataḥ tanūjasya hareḥ ca kuśa parvaṇaḥ ।ṛkṣasya ketu mālasya mama caiva gatiḥ bhavet ॥5-3-16॥

translations.english: 'Son of Vivaswan (Sugriva), the chief of vanaras, Kushaparva, Riksha (Jambavan), Ketumala and myself also will be able to reach this place.
translations.hindi: गोष्ठागार-गोष्ठं गोशाला । इदं वाजिशालादेरप्युलक्षणम्‌ । (रा०) [| नेक प्रकार के रत्नों से प्रकाशित भवनों में जो दीपक जल रहे थे, उनसे वहाँ पर प्रन्धकार नाम मात्र को भी नहीं था । ऐसी राक्षसराज रावण की लंकापुंरी को, महाकपि हनुमानजी ने देखा

verses.sloka: समीक्ष्य तु महा बाहः राघवस्य पराक्रमम् ।लक्ष्मणस्य च विक्रान्तम् अभवत् प्रीतिमान् कपिः ॥५-३-१७॥
verses.transliteration: samīkṣya tu mahā bāhaḥ rāghavasya parākramam ।lakṣmaṇasya ca vikrāntam abhavat prītimān kapiḥ ॥5-3-17॥

translations.english: Reflecting upon the valour of longarmed Rama and valiant advances of Lakshmana Hamuman felt pleased (within himself).
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार सोच विचार कर, जब हनुमान जी ने श्रोरामचन्द्र के परा- क्रम श्रौर लक्ष्मण के विक्रम की श्रोर दृष्टि डाली, तब तो वे प्रसन्न हो गए

verses.sloka: ताम् रत्न वसन उपेताम् कोष्ठ आगार अवतम्सकाम् ।यन्त्र अगार स्तनीम् ऋद्धाम् प्रमदाम् इव भूषिताम् ॥५-३-१८॥
verses.transliteration: tām ratna vasana upetām koṣṭha āgāra avatamsakām ।yantra agāra stanīm ṛddhām pramadām iva bhūṣitām ॥5-3-18॥

translations.english: Hanuman looked at the city of the demon king, whose darkness was dispelled by bright gems and mighty mansions as if it were a young maiden. The prosperous city was like a well decorated woman, adorned with ornaments having walls for her dress, the stables for her earrings, the armouries for her breasts.
translations.hindi: लंका, मणि रूपी वस्त्रों से श्रौर गोशाला श्रथवा हयशाला रूपी कणंभूषणों से श्रौर श्रायृधों के गृह रूपी स्तनों से भ्रलंकृत स्त्री की तरह, जान पड़ती थी

verses.sloka: ताम् नष्ट तिमिराम् दीपैः भास्वरैः च महा गृहैः ।नगरीम् राक्षस इन्द्रस्य ददर्श स महा कपिः ॥५-३-१९॥
verses.transliteration: tām naṣṭa timirām dīpaiḥ bhāsvaraiḥ ca mahā gṛhaiḥ ।nagarīm rākṣasa indrasya dadarśa sa mahā kapiḥ ॥5-3-19॥

translations.english: Hanuman looked at the city of the demon king, whose darkness was dispelled by bright gems and mighty mansions as if it were a young maiden. The prosperous city was like a well decorated woman, adorned with ornaments having walls for her dress, the stables for her earrings, the armouries for her breasts.

verses.sloka: अथ सा हरिशार्दूलम् प्रविशन्तिम् महाबलम् ।नगरी स्वेन रूपेण ददर्श पवनात्मजम् ॥५-३-२०॥
verses.transliteration: atha sā hariśārdūlam praviśantim mahābalam ।nagarī svena rūpeṇa dadarśa pavanātmajam ॥5-3-20॥

translations.english: Assuming her real form the presiding deity of Lanka noticed the son of the Windgod, the tiger among vanaras of great prowess entering the city.

verses.sloka: सा तम् हरिवरम् दृष्ट्वा लङ्का रावणपालिता ।स्वयमेवोत्थिता तत्र विकृताननदर्शना ॥५-३-२१॥
verses.transliteration: sā tam harivaram dṛṣṭvā laṅkā rāvaṇapālitā ।svayamevotthitā tatra vikṛtānanadarśanā ॥5-3-21॥

translations.english: Seeing the best of vanaras, the deity of the city of Lanka, ruled by Ravana rose up before him in a distorted form.

verses.sloka: पुरस्तत्क पिवर्यस्य वायुसूनोरतिष्ठत ।मुञ्चमाना महानादमब्रवीत्पवनात्मजम् ॥५-३-२२॥
verses.transliteration: purastatka pivaryasya vāyusūnoratiṣṭhata ।muñcamānā mahānādamabravītpavanātmajam ॥5-3-22॥

translations.english: She stood in front of the son of the Windgod and spoke to him in a loud voice.
translations.hindi: बह देवी, हनुमानजो की राह रोक उनके सामने जा खड़ी हुई श्रौर भयं- कर नाद कर, पवननन्दन से बोली

verses.sloka: कस्त्वम् केन च कार्येण इह प्राप्तो वनालय ।कथय स्वेह यत्तत्त्वम् यावत्प्राणा धरन्ति ते ॥५-३-२३॥
verses.transliteration: kastvam kena ca kāryeṇa iha prāpto vanālaya ।kathaya sveha yattattvam yāvatprāṇā dharanti te ॥5-3-23॥

translations.english: "O dweller of the forest, who are you? Why did you come here? Speak the truth about your identity, so long as you hold on to your life.
translations.hindi: झरे वनवासी बंदर ! तू कोन है ? और यहाँ क्यों आया है ? यदि तुझे अपने प्राण प्यारे हों तो ठीक ठीक बतला

verses.sloka: न शक्यम् खल्वियम् लङ्का प्रवेष्टुम् वानर त्वया ।रक्षिता रावणबलैरभिगुप्ता समन्ततः ॥५-३-२४॥
verses.transliteration: na śakyam khalviyam laṅkā praveṣṭum vānara tvayā ।rakṣitā rāvaṇabalairabhiguptā samantataḥ ॥5-3-24॥

translations.english: "O vanara this Lanka is a secret place protected by Ravana's army everywhere. It is surely not possible for you to enter this city".
translations.hindi: स्वेन रूपेण -भ्रषिदेवतारूपेण । ( रा० ) २ पाठान्तरे--“रावण पालिता ।” ३ पाठान्तरे--“पुरस्तात्कपिवयंस्य ।” ४ पाठान्तरे-- यावत्प्राणा ष रन्ति ते ।” ५ पाठान्तरे--'न शक्या ।” र तृतीय: सगः ५६ हे वानर ! निश्चय ही तुझमें यह सामर्थ्यं नहीं कि, तू लंका में घुस सके । क्योंकि रावण की सेना इसकी चारों ओर से रखवाली किया करती है

verses.sloka: अथ तामब्रवीद्वीरो हनुमानग्रतः स्थिताम् ।कथयिष्यामि ते तत्त्वम् यन्मम् त्वम् परिपृच्छसि ॥५-३-२५॥
verses.transliteration: atha tāmabravīdvīro hanumānagrataḥ sthitām ।kathayiṣyāmi te tattvam yanmam tvam paripṛcchasi ॥5-3-25॥

translations.english: Then Hanuman who was standing in front of her said, "I will tell you the truth since you are asking me".
translations.hindi: सामने खडी हुई उस लंका से वीर हनुमानजी ने कहा--तू मुझसे जो कुछ पूछ रही है, सो मे सब ठीक ठीक बतलाऊंगा

verses.sloka: का त्वम् विरूपनयना पुरद्वारेऽवतिष्ठसि ।किमर्थम् चापि माम् रुद्ध्वा निर्भर्त्सयसि दारुणा ॥५-३-२६॥
verses.transliteration: kā tvam virūpanayanā puradvāre'vatiṣṭhasi ।kimartham cāpi mām ruddhvā nirbhartsayasi dāruṇā ॥5-3-26॥

translations.english: "Who are you, terrible woman of ugly, distorted eyes? Why are you obstructing me at the gate of the city? Why do you impound upon me?
translations.hindi: हे निष्ठुर । [परन्तु पहिले तू तो यह बतला कि] तू कौन है, जो इस नगरद्वार पर विकराल नेत्र किए खड़ी है श्रौर क्यों मेरा मार्ग रोक कर मुझे दपट रही है

verses.sloka: हनुमद्वचनम् श्रुत्वा लङ्का सा कामरूपिणी ।उवाच वचनम् क्रुद्धा परुषं पवनात्मजम् ॥५-३-२७॥
verses.transliteration: hanumadvacanam śrutvā laṅkā sā kāmarūpiṇī ।uvāca vacanam kruddhā paruṣaṁ pavanātmajam ॥5-3-27॥

translations.english: The spirit of Lanka who could assume any form at her will got enraged on hearing the words of Hanuman and spake in a harsh tone.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी के ये वचन सुन, वह कामरूपिणी लंका की प्रधिष्ठात्री देवी क्रुद्ध हो, हनुमानजी से कठोर वचन बोली

verses.sloka: अहम् राक्षसराजस्य रावणस्य महात्मनः ।आज्ञाप्रतीक्षा दुर्धर्षा रक्षामि नगरीमिमाम् ॥५-३-२८॥
verses.transliteration: aham rākṣasarājasya rāvaṇasya mahātmanaḥ ।ājñāpratīkṣā durdharṣā rakṣāmi nagarīmimām ॥5-3-28॥

translations.english: "In obedience to the orders of the great demon king, Ravana, I am protecting this unassailable city.
translations.hindi: में महाबलवान राक्षसराज रावण की श्राज्ञानुवर्तिनी दुर्धर्षा लंका नगरी की ग्रधिष्ठात्री देवी हूं श्रौर इस पुरी की में रक्षा किया करती हैं

verses.sloka: न शक्या मामवज्ञाय प्रवेष्टुम् नगरी त्वया ।अद्य प्राणैः परित्यक्तः स्वप्स्यसे निहतो मया ॥५-३-२९॥
verses.transliteration: na śakyā māmavajñāya praveṣṭum nagarī tvayā ।adya prāṇaiḥ parityaktaḥ svapsyase nihato mayā ॥5-3-29॥

translations.english: "It is not possible for you to enter this city ignoring my presence. Soon you will be killed. You will give up your life and attain eternal sleep.

verses.sloka: अहम् हि नगरी लङ्का स्वयमेव प्लवङ्गम ।सर्वतः परिरक्षामि ह्येतत्ते कथितम् मया ॥५-३-३०॥
verses.transliteration: aham hi nagarī laṅkā svayameva plavaṅgama ।sarvataḥ parirakṣāmi hyetatte kathitam mayā ॥5-3-30॥

translations.english: "O monkey I am the presiding ogress of Lanka presenting myself personally. I am to protect this city. This is my answer to you".
translations.hindi: हे वानर ! में स्वयं लंका हूँ और में चारों ग्रोर से इसकी रखवाली किया करती हूँ । इसीसे मेने तुझको रोका है

verses.sloka: लङ्काया वचनम् श्रुत्वा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।यत्नवान्स हरिश्रेष्ठः स्थितश्शैल इवापरः ॥५-३-३१॥
verses.transliteration: laṅkāyā vacanam śrutvā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।yatnavānsa hariśreṣṭhaḥ sthitaśśaila ivāparaḥ ॥5-3-31॥

translations.english: On hearing the words of ogress of Lanka, the son of the Windgod stood up ready and appeared like another mountain.
translations.hindi: उद्योगी एवं कपिश्रेष्ठ पवननन्दन हनुमान जी ने लंका की ये बातें सुनीं, उसे परास्त करने के लिए उसके सामने एक दूसरे पर्वत की तरह भ्रचल भाव से खडे हो गए

verses.sloka: स ताम् स्त्रीरूपविकृताम् दृष्ट्वा वानरपुङ्गवः ।आबभाषेऽथ मेधावि सत्त्वान् प्लवगर्षभः ॥५-३-३२॥
verses.transliteration: sa tām strīrūpavikṛtām dṛṣṭvā vānarapuṅgavaḥ ।ābabhāṣe'tha medhāvi sattvān plavagarṣabhaḥ ॥5-3-32॥

translations.english: Seeing the monster of a woman, the powerful Hanuman, bull among vanaras endowed with wisdom spoke to her.
translations.hindi: वानरश्रेष्ठ, बुद्धिमान एवं बलवान्‌ हनुमान जी, उस रूपघारिणी लंका देवी से बोले

verses.sloka: द्रक्ष्यामि नगरीम् लङ्काम् साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम् ।इत्यर्थमिह सम्प्राप्तः परम् कौतूहलम् हि मे ॥५-३-३३॥
verses.transliteration: drakṣyāmi nagarīm laṅkām sāṭṭaprākāratoraṇām ।ityarthamiha samprāptaḥ param kautūhalam hi me ॥5-3-33॥

translations.english: "I would like to see this Lanka with marketplaces, gateways and ramparts. I have come here for that purpose. My curiosity has been roused to see this place.
translations.hindi: हे लंके ! में इस नगरी की भ्रटारियाँ, प्राकार, तोरण, वन, उपवन तथा प्रधान प्रधान भवनों को देखना चाहता श्रौर इसीलिए में यहाँ श्राया भी हु । मुझे लंकापुरी को देखने का बड़ा कुतूहल है

verses.sloka: वनान्युपवनानीह लङ्कायाः काननानि च ।सर्वतो गृहमुख्यानि द्रष्टुमागमनम् हि मे ॥५-३-३४॥
verses.transliteration: vanānyupavanānīha laṅkāyāḥ kānanāni ca ।sarvato gṛhamukhyāni draṣṭumāgamanam hi me ॥5-3-34॥

translations.english: "I have arrived here to see Lanka's gardens, groves and forests and also all the important houses".

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनम् श्रुत्वा लङ्का सा कामरूपिणी ।भूय एव पुनर्वाक्यम् बभाषे परुषाक्षरम् ॥५-३-३५॥
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanam śrutvā laṅkā sā kāmarūpiṇī ।bhūya eva punarvākyam babhāṣe paruṣākṣaram ॥5-3-35॥

translations.english: On hearing Hanuman, the ogress of Lanka, who could assume any form, replied in harsh words:
translations.hindi: उस कामरूपिणी लंकादेवी ने हनुमानजी के ये वचन सुन, फिर हनुमान जी से कठोर वचन कहे

verses.sloka: मामनिर्जत्य दुर्बद्धे राक्षसेश्वरपालिता ।न शक्यमद्य ते द्रष्टुम् पुरीयम् वनराधम ॥५-३-३६॥
verses.transliteration: māmanirjatya durbaddhe rākṣaseśvarapālitā ।na śakyamadya te draṣṭum purīyam vanarādhama ॥5-3-36॥

translations.english: "O evilminded, foolish monkey It is not possible for you to enter the city ruled by Ravana, the king of demons without conquering me".
translations.hindi: हे दुब ढ ! हे वानराधम ! राक्षसेश्वर रावण द्वारा रक्षित इस लंका- पुरी को, मुझे हराए बिना प्रब तू नहीं देख सकता

verses.sloka: ततः स कपिशार्दूलस्तामुवाच निशाचरीम् ।दृष्वा पुरीमिमाम् भद्रे पुनर्यास्ये यथागतम् ॥५-३-३७॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa kapiśārdūlastāmuvāca niśācarīm ।dṛṣvā purīmimām bhadre punaryāsye yathāgatam ॥5-3-37॥

translations.english: The tiger among monkeys said to the, the nightwalker "O noble Lanka I shall see this city and go back".
translations.hindi: तंदनन्तर कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी ने उस निशाचरी से कहा--हे भद्रे ! मे एक बार इस लंकापुरी को देख, जहाँ से श्राया हूँ, वहीं लौट कर चला. जाऊंगा

verses.sloka: ततः कृत्वा महानादम् सा वै लङ्का भयावहम् ।तलेन वानरश्रेष्ठम् ताडयामास वेगिता ॥५-३-३८॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṛtvā mahānādam sā vai laṅkā bhayāvaham ।talena vānaraśreṣṭham tāḍayāmāsa vegitā ॥5-3-38॥

translations.english: Then the ogress of Lanka made a loud and frightening sound and struck the most powerful vanara with the palm of her hand.

verses.sloka: ततः स कपिशार्दुलो लङ्काया ताडितो भृशम् ।ननाद सुमहानादम् वीर्यवान् पवनात्मजः ॥५-३-३९॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa kapiśārdulo laṅkāyā tāḍito bhṛśam ।nanāda sumahānādam vīryavān pavanātmajaḥ ॥5-3-39॥

translations.english: At this strong slap, the heroic Hanuman, son of the Windgod roared loudly.

verses.sloka: ततः सम्वर्तयामास वामहस्तस्य सोऽङ्गुLईः ।मुष्ह्टिनाभिजघूनैनाम् हनुमान् क्रोधमूर्चितः ॥५-३-४०॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samvartayāmāsa vāmahastasya so'ṅguLīḥ ।muṣhṭinābhijaghūnainām hanumān krodhamūrcitaḥ ॥5-3-40॥

translations.english: Overcome by anger, Hanuman clenched the fingers of his left hand and hit her with his fist. Considering her to be, after all, a woman he did not turn outrageous.
translations.hindi: श्रौर बाँये हाथ की ग्रंगुलियाँ मोड़ श्रौर मुट्ठी बाँध हनुमानजी ने क्रुद्ध हो, लंका के एक घू सा मारा

verses.sloka: स्त्री चेति मन्यमानेन नातिक्रोधः स्वयम् कृतः ।सा तु तेन प्रहारेण विह्वलाङ्गी नीशाचरी ॥५-३-४१॥
verses.transliteration: strī ceti manyamānena nātikrodhaḥ svayam kṛtaḥ ।sā tu tena prahāreṇa vihvalāṅgī nīśācarī ॥5-3-41॥

translations.english: Struck by the blow of Hanuman the demoness fell down on the ground at once, her limbs shattered, her face distorted.
translations.hindi: तिस पर भो लंका को स्त्री समझ हनुमानजी ने बहुत क्रोध नहीं किया था, किन्तु वह राक्षसी लंका उतने ही प्रहार से विकल भ्रोर लोट पोट हो पृथ्वी पर गिर पड़ी और उसका मुख और भी प्रधिक विकराल हो गया । उसको भूमि पर छटपटाते देख, बुद्धिमान एबं तेजस्वी हनुमान जी को

verses.sloka: पपात सहसा भूमौ विकृताननदर्शना ।ततस्तु हनुमान् प्राज्ञस्ताम् दृष्ट्वा विनिपातिताम् ॥५-३-४२॥
verses.transliteration: papāta sahasā bhūmau vikṛtānanadarśanā ।tatastu hanumān prājñastām dṛṣṭvā vinipātitām ॥5-3-42॥

translations.english: Wise and brilliant Hanuman, seeing the deity fallen down, left her (without killing her) out of compassion, thinking that she is a woman, after all.

verses.sloka: कृपाम् चकार तेजस्वी मन्यमानः स्त्रियम् तु ताम् ।ततो वै भृशसम्विग्ना लङ्का गद्गदाक्षरम् ॥५-३-४३॥
verses.transliteration: kṛpām cakāra tejasvī manyamānaḥ striyam tu tām ।tato vai bhṛśasamvignā laṅkā gadgadākṣaram ॥5-3-43॥

translations.english: Thereafter, the deflated demoness of Lanka with an agitated voice, said to Hanuman, the monkeyhero:
translations.hindi: उसे स्त्री समझ उस पर बड़ी दया श्राई । तदनन्तर भ्रत्यन्त विकल बह लंकादेवी, गद्गद्‌ वाणी से भ्रमिमान रहित हो कपिवर हनुमान जी से बोली । 'हे कपिश्चेष्ठ ! हे महाबाहो ! तुम मेरे ऊपर प्रसन्न हो श्रौर मुझे बचाझो

verses.sloka: उवाचागर्वितम् वाक्यम् हनूमन्तम् प्लवङ्गमम् ।प्रसीद सुमहाबाहो त्रायस्व हरिसत्तम ॥५-३-४४॥
verses.transliteration: uvācāgarvitam vākyam hanūmantam plavaṅgamam ।prasīda sumahābāho trāyasva harisattama ॥5-3-44॥

translations.english: "O, strongshouldered great monkey be gracious. Save me. Heroes endowed with great strength stay back when the time comes.

verses.sloka: समये सौम्य तिष्ठन्ति स्त्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः ।अहं तु नगरी लङ्का स्वयमेव प्लवङ्गम ॥५-३-४५॥
verses.transliteration: samaye saumya tiṣṭhanti sttvavanto mahābalāḥ ।ahaṁ tu nagarī laṅkā svayameva plavaṅgama ॥5-3-45॥

translations.english: "O monkey I am Lanka incarnate. You have conquered me by your strength and valour.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि जो धैयंवान्‌ श्रोर महाबली पुरुष होते हे, बे स्त्री का वध नहीं करते । हे वानर ! म॑ ही लंका नगरी की अ्रधिष्ठात्री देवी हैं

verses.sloka: निर्जिताहम् त्वया वीर विक्रमेण महाबल ।इदम् तु तथ्यम् शृणु वै ब्रुवन्त्य मे हरीश्वर ॥५-३-४६॥
verses.transliteration: nirjitāham tvayā vīra vikrameṇa mahābala ।idam tu tathyam śṛṇu vai bruvantya me harīśvara ॥5-3-46॥

translations.english: "O lord of vanaras in the past Creator Brahma had given me a boon which has come true. I will tell you. listen.
translations.hindi: सो है महाबली ! तुमने मुझे अपने पराक्रम से जीत लिया । महाकपीदवर! में जो अब यथार्थं वृत्तान्त कहती हूँ, उसे तुम सुनो

verses.sloka: स्वयम्भुवा पुरा दत्तम् वरदानम् यथा मम ।यदा त्वाम् वानरः कश्चिद्विक्रमाद्वशमानयेत् ॥५-३-४७॥
verses.transliteration: svayambhuvā purā dattam varadānam yathā mama ।yadā tvām vānaraḥ kaścidvikramādvaśamānayet ॥5-3-47॥

translations.english: 'When a vanara vanquishes you by his prowess, you may know that destruction of ogres will set in.
translations.hindi: ब्रह्माजी ने प्राचीनकाल में मुझको यह वरदान दिया था कि, जब तुझको कोई वानर परास्त करे

verses.sloka: तदा त्वया हि विज्ञेयम् रक्षसाम् भयामागतम् ।स हि म् समयः सौम्य प्राप्तोऽय तव द्र्शनात् ॥५-३-४८॥
verses.transliteration: tadā tvayā hi vijñeyam rakṣasām bhayāmāgatam ।sa hi m samayaḥ saumya prāpto'ya tava drśanāt ॥5-3-48॥

translations.english: "O gentle one the time ordained by Brahma has come today with your presence here. The truth revealed by Brahma, the selfborn, cannot be proved otherwise.
translations.hindi: तब तू जान लेना कि, ग्रम राक्षसों के ऊपर विपत्ति ग्रा पहुंची । सो हे सौम्य ! तुम्हारे दर्शन से श्राज मेरा वह समय श्रा गया

verses.sloka: स्वयम्भूविहितः सत्यो न तस्यास्ति व्यतिक्रमः ।सीतानिमित्तंम् राज्ञस्तु रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ॥५-३-४९॥
verses.transliteration: svayambhūvihitaḥ satyo na tasyāsti vyatikramaḥ ।sītānimittaṁm rājñastu rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ॥5-3-49॥

translations.english: "The ruin of all demons and evilminded king Ravana will take place due to (the abduction of) Sita.

verses.sloka: विधत्स्व सर्वकार्याणि यानि यानिह वाञ्चसि ।तत्प्रविश्य हरिश्रेष्ठम् पुरीम् रावणपालिताम् ॥५-३-५०॥
verses.transliteration: vidhatsva sarvakāryāṇi yāni yāniha vāñcasi ।tatpraviśya hariśreṣṭham purīm rāvaṇapālitām ॥5-3-50॥

translations.english: "O great vanara enter the city ruled by Ravana and accomplish your purpose.
translations.hindi: सो है कविश्रेष्ठ ! तुम अब रावण द्वारा पालित इस पुरी में प्रवेश कर, जो कुछ करना चाहते हो, करो

verses.sloka: विधत्स्व सर्वकार्याण् यानि यानीह वाञ्चसि ।प्रविश्य शापोपहताम् हरीश्वर ।शुभाम् पुरीम् राक्षसराजपालिताम् ।यदृच्छया त्वम् जनकात्मजाम् सतीम् ।विमार्ग सर्वत्र गतो यथासुखम् ॥५-३-५१॥
verses.transliteration: vidhatsva sarvakāryāṇ yāni yānīha vāñcasi ।praviśya śāpopahatām harīśvara ।śubhām purīm rākṣasarājapālitām ।yadṛcchayā tvam janakātmajām satīm ।vimārga sarvatra gato yathāsukham ॥5-3-51॥

translations.english: "O lord of vanaras you may search for the chaste lady, daughter of king Janaka all over freely entering this doomed city, ruled by the chief of demons. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायाणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे तृतीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the third sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
